# Read the file
with open('django/contrib/admin/options.py', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# The original code block
old_code = '''            if formset.is_valid():
                changecount = 0
                for form in formset.forms:
                    if form.has_changed():
                        obj = self.save_form(request, form, change=True)
                        self.save_model(request, obj, form, change=True)
                        self.save_related(request, form, formsets=[], change=True)
                        change_msg = self.construct_change_message(request, form, None)
                        self.log_change(request, obj, change_msg)
                        changecount += 1'''

# The new code block with transaction
new_code = '''            if formset.is_valid():
                changecount = 0
                with transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model)):
                    for form in formset.forms:
                        if form.has_changed():
                            obj = self.save_form(request, form, change=True)
                            self.save_model(request, obj, form, change=True)
                            self.save_related(request, form, formsets=[], change=True)
                            change_msg = self.construct_change_message(request, form, None)
                            self.log_change(request, obj, change_msg)
                            changecount += 1'''

if old_code in content:
    # Replace old code with new code
    new_content = content.replace(old_code, new_code)
    with open('django/contrib/admin/options.py', 'w') as f:
        f.write(new_content)
    print("File updated successfully")
else:
    print("Could not find the expected code block")
EOF
